effects.prompt: Choose: each hero creates a Quicken token?
Choose: each hero draws a card?

_comment:
'When this hits, choose any number: Each hero creates a Quicken token / Each hero draws a card / Each hero gains 1{h}.'

Trigger: TRIGGERED + ON_HIT on the attack card itself (an Action - Attack is not an ATTACK_REACTION). The text says 'When this hits', NOT 'hits a hero', so deliberately NO ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate - unlike Clear Conscience in this batch.

'Choose any number' DEVIATES FROM THE OBVIOUS READING of the triage list's MAY and from MODAL/CHOOSE: CHOOSE picks exactly ONE option per resolution (effect_types.py:5107-5136 - a single _ask_player, no multi-select, no used-mode tracking), and MODAL chooses at PLAY time while release note 4 says 'You choose the modes after this has hit'. So the expressible form is three independent MAY blocks in printed order, one per mode: each is offered once (a mode cannot be picked twice - release note 5), declining all three is 'choose 0' (release note 6), and accepting runs that mode for both heroes. Known approximation: printed chooses all modes up front then resolves them; here each mode resolves immediately after its yes/no. Release note 7 ('no priority between any of the effects') plus these effects having no internal player choices means the interleaving is outcome-identical in practice.

'Each hero': DRAW reads player via _effect_player_id (OPPONENT -> 3-cid, effect_types.py:807-837); GAIN reads player the same way and LIFE_POINTS routes to effect_gain_life (effect_types.py:4890-4896) - release note 8 confirms the green symbol is life; CREATE_TOKEN handles OPPONENT explicitly (effect_types.py:1971-1972). json/tokens/quicken.json exists.
